svg.title: Signet7 — original technical drawing, homepage sheet
svg.desc: Drawn from scratch. Cryptographic seal on high-stakes email. Two facts at check. Recipients never install.
svg.text: A cryptographic seal on the email that can
move money, a job, or a client. Two facts at
check. A signed file you keep.
Recipients never install. Match is not advice to pay.
ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES · TOL ±0.5 UNLESS NOTED
Cryptographic seal on the outgoing message.
Words on the page are bound to the seal.
The sender is listed for this address, or is
not. That is the second fact.
A signed file you keep. Not a screenshot. Not a
Recipients never install. They open the live
2. Two facts: words match the seal; that sender is listed.
3. Match is not advice to pay. Unsealed mail is ordinary mail.
GRID ON · SNAP ON · ORTHO ON · UNITS mm · THIRD ANGLE
